entries.en: I've just come by for a spell. Saul needn't know a thing.
entries.ro: Am trecut doar pe-aici, pentru o vreme. Saul n-are de ce să afle.

entries.en: Mhm. And who's this?
My babysitter.
Fuck you too.
What brings you to these parts, city girl?
entries.ro: Ce te aduce pe-aici, fată de oraș?

entries.en: Do you have any idea how angry the old man's going to be when he sees you here?
entries.ro: Ai idee cât de furios o să fie bătrânul când te vede aici?

entries.en: Not this time. We're needed here.
entries.ro: Nu de data asta. Aici avem nevoie de noi.

entries.en: OK. Well... I'll need that rifle of yours. And some of my own stuff.
entries.ro: Ok. Păi... Îmi trebuie pușca ta. Și niște chestii de-ale mele.

entries.en: Take whatever you want.
Yeah... Thanks, guys. I'll grab the gear, then be out of your hair.
entries.ro: Da... Mersi, băieți. Iau tot ce-mi trebuie și vă las în pace.

entries.en: The big city got too small for her.
entries.ro: Orașul mare s-a făcut prea mic pentru ea.

entries.en: Hey.
Not a babysitter. Partner in crime.
Hey, guys.
Well, might not've needed a babysitter if you hadn't lost the merch and the car.
entries.ro: Păi, poate n-aveam nevoie de babysitter dacă nu pierdeai marfa și mașina.

entries.en: Shut it, V.
Heh, are you kidding? Did that beauty Thorton of yours finally bite it?
entries.ro: Heh, glumești? Frumoasa ta Thorton a crăpat în sfârșit?

entries.en: She rode it to death in ol' Night City.
entries.ro: A mânat-o până a crăpat, prin bătrânul Night City.

entries.en: Nah. It got klepped.
Shit, who dared?
It doesn't matter. I'll get her back – that's why I'm here.
entries.ro: Nu contează. O recuperez – de-aia sunt aici.

entries.en: Not a babysitter. Partner in crime.
Mhm.
Yep. She can't function without me.
entries.ro: Da. Nu poate funcționa fără mine.

entries.en: Hello.
Fuck, I don't believe this.
The Raffens screwed me over. I'll get them back, but I need your help.
entries.ro: Gașca Raffens mi-a tras țeapă. Le-o întorc, dar am nevoie de tine.

entries.en: You know we would do anything for you, sister…
entries.ro: Știi că am face orice pentru tine, soră…

entries.en: Generators? You won't help because of some goddamn generators? Is this another joke?
entries.ro: Generatoare? Nu ajuți din cauza unor nenorocite de generatoare? Asta-i iar o glumă?

entries.en: Seriously – you won't help?
So you'll stay put because Saul told you to? You couldn't care less about me?
entries.ro: Deci rămâneți pe loc pentru că v-a zis Saul? Nu vă pasă deloc de mine?

entries.en: Panam...
So… I'm off.
Yeah, yeah... Go on, go, already! Call us sometime!
entries.ro: Da, da... Du-te odată! Sună-ne și tu pe la noi!

entries.en: Looks like you're stuck with me.
entries.ro: Se pare că ai rămas cu mine.

entries.en: Hey, Panam.
Hey, Panam. Are you staying a while?
Did you figure out your differences with Saul? Will you come back?
entries.ro: V-ați împăcat cu Saul? Te întorci?

entries.en: Panaaam! You'll stop by later, right, honey?
entries.ro: Panaaam! Treci pe la noi mai târziu, da, scumpo?

entries.en: Have you brought someone new? Does Saul know?
entries.ro: Ai adus pe cineva nou? Știe Saul?

entries.en: No. I'll be going again soon. We'll talk next time.
entries.ro: Nu. Plec iar în curând. Vorbim data viitoare.

entries.en: Next time, Ellie. I promise.
Not your concern, friend.
Keep an eye on her, V!
Mmhm.
Well, would you look what the cat dragged in!
Is that a ghost or is it just my hangover?!
entries.ro: E o fantomă sau doar mahmureala mea?!

entries.en: Listen – we can't leave camp, no chance. But... but, Saul never said a thing about gear.
entries.ro: Ascultă – nu putem părăsi tabăra, nicio șansă. Dar... dar Saul n-a zis nimic despre echipament.

entries.en: V, this is Scorpion, Mitch. Two old friends.
entries.ro: V, ăsta e Scorpion, Mitch. Doi prieteni vechi.

entries.en: Come with me. We'll thrash 'em, the four of us.
entries.ro: Vino cu mine. Îi spargem, noi patru.

entries.en: But now – now's hard.
And take care of yourself out there.
entries.ro: Și ai grijă de tine pe-acolo.

entries.en: This isn't about Saul, it's about the clan. You know that.
entries.ro: Nu e despre Saul, e despre clan. Știi asta.

entries.en: You disappointed?
I don't know. Maybe a little, yes.
entries.ro: Nu știu. Poate un pic, da.

entries.en: [Take box] What's in it?
All right, that's everything. Let's go.
entries.ro: Bine, asta e tot. Hai să mergem.

entries.en: V, take the box, please, and let's go.
entries.ro: V, ia cutia, te rog, și hai să mergem.

entries.en: Will you take the box, please?
Put it in the trunk.
V, time's running, running, running.
The box goes in the trunk. Let's go.
entries.ro: Cutia în portbagaj. Hai să mergem.

entries.en: [Place inside]
Will you help me with this?
C'mon, we're wasting time.
Need your help.
entries.ro: Am nevoie de o mână de ajutor.

entries.en: We'll manage without 'em.
With what? What's this about?
entries.ro: Cu ce? Despre ce e vorba?

entries.en: Raffens screwed Panam. Plan is to show 'em that was a bad idea.
entries.ro: Gașca Raffens i-a tras țeapă lui Panam. Planul e să le arătăm că a fost o idee proastă.

entries.en: How bad did they get you?
Bad enough to make me sit quietly through all your bullshit.
entries.ro: Destul de rău cât să stau liniștit prin toată vrăjeala ta.

entries.en: Really could use you guys.
entries.ro: Chiar aș avea nevoie de voi.

entries.en: Really could use your help.
entries.ro: Chiar mi-ar prinde bine o mână de ajutor.

entries.en: Shut it.
Don't be a dick, Mitch. Help me.
We need your help.
We'll be fine without them.
What's inside?
Panam, time's short, c'mon.
I know.
Ah well, the old man told us to sit tight and get those generators back up after the batteries went kaput.
entries.ro: Eh, bătrânul a zis să stăm pe loc și să pornim iar generatoarele, că bateriile au dat colț.

entries.en: A few odds and ends that should be useful. Take it.
entries.ro: Niște chestii care ar trebui să ne prindă bine. Ia-le.

entries.en: [Get out]
We can go. Hop in.
[Get in]
